@Uniswap Most agent platforms bolt on a Uniswap wrapper and call it done — the agent can swap, but it doesn't know anything about what it's swapping or why.

We improve on the underlying tools before we integrate them: our quoter reads pool data directly from Clawnch's on-chain contracts to get accurate prices that generic wrappers can't, our swap system automatically compares two price sources and picks the better deal, and every trade feeds into portfolio tracking, conditional orders, and risk management without extra configuration.

The result isn't a bot that executes a fixed script — it's an agent that understands its own financial position and acts on it. We're building compounding infrastructure where each new capability makes every previous one more useful, because that's what it takes for agents to operate as real economic participants.

tweets.text:
Dollar-based swaps + an AI copilot turns @CryptoRubic  from “quote engine” into an all-in-one trading hub. The roadmap literally spells it out: dollar-based trades, portfolio tracking, AI assistant, charts, gasless, and a lite mode rolling out over the next months. That’s decisioning + execution on one screen, not five tabs.

Why it matters: quoting in USD kills mental math; an AI assistant can pre-check routes, fees, and slippage; gasless removes the “no SOL/ETH for fees” trap; lite mode and portfolio keep newcomers moving without context switches. (Charts are already live inside Best Rate Finder trend check right at confirm.)

How I’ll test it (receipts > vibes):
• The week these land, run a 30-min live session mirroring my current flow.
• Measure time-to-decision (ms from first quote to confirm), clicks to fill, and quote→fill delta (bps) across 6 swaps (EVM + SOL).
• Post a before/after clip + 2 tx hashes. If USD quoting + AI + gasless cut decision time and p95 bps drift, that’s the headline: execution speed is a product feature.

Dev nudge: expose a tiny “Decision Trace” (inputs checked by AI, routes compared, fee provenance) so power users can see why the copilot recommended a path right in the confirm pane.
